Arrogancia]] |local_council = |blank2_name = Congressional Bloc |blank2_info = Majority |next = |previous = }} '''Quezon's 3rd congressional district''', also known as the '''[[Bondoc Peninsula]]''', is one of the four [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Quezon]], formerly '''Tayabas'''. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |access-date=October 7, 2020}} The district consists of municipalities in the [[Bondoc Peninsula]], the southern part of [[Tayabas Isthmus]] and southwest coast of [[Ragay Gulf]], namely [[Agdangan]], [[Buenavista, Quezon|Buenavista]], [[Catanauan]], [[General Luna, Quezon|General Luna]], [[Macalelon]], [[Mulanay]], [[Padre Burgos, Quezon|Padre Burgos]], [[Pitogo, Quezon|Pitogo]], [[San Andres, Quezon|San Andres]], [[San Francisco, Quezon|San Francisco]], [[San Narciso, Quezon|San Narciso]] and [[Unisan, Quezon|Unisan]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Reynante Arrogancia|Reynante Arrogancia]] of the [[Nationalist People's Coalition]] and [[Stand Up Quezon]].{{cite web|title=House Members|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/members/|publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]|accessdate=September 19, 2023}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Legislature ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | [[Local government in the Philippines|Constituency]] |- !Start!!End |- | colspan="10" style="text-align:center;" | District created February 2, 1987. |- | style="text-align:center;" | '''1''' | style="color:inherit;background:{{party color|United Nationalist Democratic Organization}};" | | [[File:Bienvenido Marquez Jr.jpg|100px]] | Bienvenido O.
